create.title: Make a video
create.intro: Say what the video should be about. Your Claude Code writes the script first, and you check it before anything is made.
create.promptHelp: Example: 20-second birthday wish for my sister Anu, from all of us at home.
create.example1: Birthday wish for my sister Anu, from all of us at home.
create.example2: Onam offer at our textile shop: 15% off all sarees till Thiruvonam.
create.example3: Three quick tips to remember what you study, for exam week.
create.example4: Invitation to our church youth meet on Sunday 7 December, 4 pm.
create.contactHelp: Shown at the end exactly as you type it: a phone number, an address, or a line like “With love, Amma”.
create.logoHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
create.promptTooShort: Write a few words about your video.
create.logoTooBig: The logo must be a JPG, PNG or WebP under 5 MB.
draft.waitingHelp: Your Claude Code is turning your idea into short shots: the words, the pictures and the order. You check everything before any video is made.
review.label: Label
review.note: Your Claude Code makes the video on this computer. It usually takes 10 to 60 minutes, depending on the model.
review.minScenes: A video needs at least 6 shots.
progress.title: Making your video
progress.closeOk: You can close this page; keep genreel running. The video will be in My videos.
progress.time: Usually 10 to 60 minutes, depending on the model in Settings.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notFound: This video does not exist or belongs to someone else.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong on this page
errorPage.body: Try again. If it keeps happening, write to us from the Contact page.
create.promptTip: Say what it is for, the details people need (dates, prices, names), and who it is for.

steps.label: Progress
videos.subtitle: Every video made on this computer. Open one to continue, watch or download.
review.heading: Check your script
review.intro: {n} shots. Change any words, swap a picture, move or remove shots. Nothing is made until you press the button.
review.wordsHint: {n} words (use 3 to {max}). These words are spoken and shown as captions.
draft.elapsed: {s} s so far. Usually 20 to 40 seconds.
draft.slow: This is taking longer than usual. You can leave this page; the script will be waiting in My videos.
draft.next1: You'll see each shot: the words that are spoken and shown as captions, and the picture for it.
draft.next2: Change any words, swap a picture for your own photo, move or remove shots.
draft.next3: Nothing is made until you press Make the video.
review.introList: Read it through like a script. Tap any shot to change its words, number or picture. Nothing is made until you press Make the video.
review.currentNote: It stays as it is until you make the video again and the new one is ready.
review.problems: {n} shot(s) need fewer or more words.
errors.scriptTooLong: This script is too long for the video length. Press Edit the script and shorten a few shots, then make the video again.
create.note: Nothing is made until you approve the script.

progress.inLine: Waiting for the video before it. You are number {n} in line.
progress.stopConfirm: Stop making this video? The script stays, and you can try again.
result.savedNote: Saved on this computer. Download it, or open its folder.
result.deleteConfirm: Delete this video, its script and its files from this computer?
errors.failed: Something went wrong while making the video. Try again.
errors.interrupted: genreel was closed while this was being made. Try again.
errors.limit: Your Claude plan has reached its usage limit for now. Try again later.
errors.needsVoiceKey: This language needs an ElevenLabs key for the voice. Add one in Settings.
errors.noClaude: Claude Code could not be started. Check that it is installed and signed in (run claude in a terminal).
errors.photo: One of the pictures could not be used.
errors.tooSlow: Making the video took longer than the time limit in Settings.
errors.wrongLength: The video came out the wrong length. Try again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: genreel runs on this computer. Videos are made by your own Claude Code, on your own Claude plan.
settings.videoModelHelp: Opus makes better videos but takes longer and uses more of your plan.
settings.scriptModelHelp: Sonnet is fast and good at scripts.
settings.minutesHelp: genreel stops a video that takes longer than this.
settings.voiceIntro: English and Hindi use a free voice that runs on this computer. For Malayalam and Tamil, or a more natural voice in any language, add your own ElevenLabs key (the free ElevenLabs plan works).
settings.keyHelp: Stored only on this computer and sent only to ElevenLabs.
settings.keySaved: A key is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
settings.keyWrong: ElevenLabs did not accept this key.
settings.filesHelp: Scripts, videos and settings are saved in this folder:
